run_GTNLoss: run the GTNLoss function to compute sequence criterion loss between frame-level input and token-level target
create_GTNLossFunction: create a custom PyTorch autograd Function using GTN graphs for sequence alignment loss computation
build_make_target_graph: build a target graph from a token sequence where each token can align to one or more input frames
review_forward_backward: review the GTNLossFunction forward and backward methods that compute loss and gradients in parallel over a batch
test_GTNLoss_example: test the GTNLoss example by running main to compute loss and gradients on random input and target tensors
